blocking_findings.finding: The metrics contract cannot support its required assertions. It is described as timestamped event names and explicitly as “counters only, no payloads,” but P-3/P-4b require correlating each renderStart, renderCancel, and renderSettle to a specific page/task and render generation. Without stable identifiers, the implementation cannot prove zero orphaned starts, distinguish superseded and replacement generations, or assert cancel → cancelled settle → replacement start ordering. The append-only global event stream is also unbounded despite the feature’s bounded-memory requirement.
blocking_findings.required_change: Define one consistent, testable metrics event schema containing at least sequence/timestamp, document instance, page, render task, generation, event kind, terminal outcome, and relevant scale/backing dimensions. Specify a bounded retention policy or explicit reset/snapshot mechanism that preserves each QA run’s complete evidence without allowing production memory to grow indefinitely. Reconcile the “counters only/no payloads” wording everywhere and add unit acceptance for correlation, reset/retention, and exactly-one terminal settle per start.

blocking_findings.finding: The clean-baseline evidence is stored only under `/tmp/fn112-baseline/`, with no durable manifest, hashes, environment metadata, or regeneration path. That location can disappear between the seven tasks or across implementation sessions, leaving later comparisons and the final R17 receipt unverifiable and non-repeatable.
blocking_findings.required_change: Define a durable in-repository Flow evidence artifact or task receipt containing command, exit status, relevant output, base SHA, Bun/platform versions, and timestamps. Permit deterministic regeneration from an isolated worktree at `bb994b580356a41a31093fea85b06993c1a18e4c` if the temporary raw logs disappear, while retaining the rule that the initial baseline is captured before product/dependency edits.

non_blocking_observations.observation: Prior blockers P1-P11 are otherwise genuinely repaired: P-4a and P-4b are executable and separated, auxiliary cMap/font 404 behavior is observation-driven without an invented document-load fallback, worker failure is the sole deterministic bootstrap UI case, and branch metadata matches `feat/native-pdf-renderer`.

Range parsing, root/candidate realpath canonicalization, fail-closed non-ENOENT handling, strict vendor-route validation, GET/HEAD behavior, CSP preservation, and image regression coverage are sufficiently explicit.

The clean offline run, auxiliary-failure runs, installed-global-package byte comparison, deterministic R8 injection, three text-alignment captures, visual QA matrix, and raw P-1…P-6 evidence are appropriately separated.

coverage_summary: The seven-task DAG validates and is consistent across MD/JSON: .2 → .1 → .3 → .4 → .5 → .6 → .7. R1-R19 are mapped, and the plan is strong on local worker/cMaps/fonts, package pinning and smoke, Range/realpath containment, strict CSP/framing, safe annotations and no scripting/embedding, StrictMode and stale races, virtualization/cancellation/DPR limits, extracted-text fallback and deep links, accessibility, deterministic fixtures/state injection, offline proof, Scholarly Dusk visual QA, and documentation/no-publication boundaries. P1-P11 and N1-N10 are materially incorporated. Implementation must still wait because the required performance/lifecycle evidence cannot be derived from the stated payload-free metrics channel, its append-only lifetime violates bounded-memory intent, and the baseline evidence is not durable or repeatably attributable.
